info.name: Haki Afya API
info.description: Every endpoint in document.md section 9, as User journeys. Run the folders in order (Reports depend on earlier state). Bill Check calls Gemma: allow up to 90 s.

exec: pm.test("nearest is Demo Hospital Kilimani", () => pm.expect(b.facilities[0].id === 'd001').to.be.true);
pm.test("sorted by distance", () => pm.expect(b.facilities.every((f, i, a) => i === 0 || a[i-1].distance_km <= f.distance_km)).to.be.true);

item.name: Search: demo -> Demo Facilities, not contracted

exec: pm.test("all demo, none contracted", () => pm.expect(b.facilities.every(f => f.is_demo && !f.contracted)).to.be.true);
